from itertools import combinations
from pysat.solvers import Solver
n=21
# lex order map variable index 1..210, True=1 blue, False=0 red
edge_to_var={}
edges=[]
v=1
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        edge_to_var[(i,j)]=v
        edges.append((i,j))
        v+=1
clauses=[]
for S in combinations(range(n),5):
    evars=[edge_to_var[(i,j)] for i,j in combinations(S,2)]
    clauses.append(evars[:])       # at least one blue (not all red)
    clauses.append([-x for x in evars]) # at least one red (not all blue)
print('vars',v-1,'clauses',len(clauses))
start=None
with Solver(name='cadical153', bootstrap_with=clauses) as solver:
    sat=solver.solve()
    print('sat',sat)
    if sat:
        model=solver.get_model()
        vals=[1 if model[idx-1]>0 else 0 for idx in range(1,v)]
        print(len(vals))
        print(vals)
        # verify
        bad=[]
        for S in combinations(range(n),5):
            colors=[]
            for i,j in combinations(S,2):
                colors.append(vals[edge_to_var[(i,j)]-1])
            if all(c==0 for c in colors) or all(c==1 for c in colors):
                bad.append((S,colors[0]))
                break
        print('bad',bad[:1])
